patch_description: Instead of a single greedy pass with one fixed ordering, run greedy placement from many different model orderings (sorted by r/s descending, ascending, density, req_rate, model_size, plus seeded random shuffles), then improve the best candidate with a simple local search that moves a model between GPUs whenever it lowers the max KVPR. Finally return the best placement found. This candidate-diversity approach directly extends the proven winning pattern while local search squeezes out further gains at negligible runtime.
